title: Malicious code in sedgehaul (PyPI)
description: The sedgehaul package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a coordinated malicious campaign involving loader packages that download and execute remote malicious scripts. These packages do not contain the payload themselves but serve as deceptive loaders to facilitate malicious code execution. The campaign is identified as having clear malicious intent, including potential infostealing activities.
